task: Audit a Google Ads client account under a manager account, research targeting and keywords, then build and verify a new search campaign with budget, targeting, keywords, ads, and assets.

queries.query: google ads get manager client accounts
queries.intent: list accounts under a manager account in google ads

queries.query: google ads audit campaigns keywords performance
queries.intent: audit google ads account performance campaigns ad groups and keywords

queries.query: google ads create mutate campaigns budgets keywords ads assets
queries.intent: create campaign budget keywords ads and assets in google ads

queries.query: google ads mutate operations campaigns keywords ad groups ads
queries.intent: mutate campaigns ad groups keywords and ads in google ads

executions.purpose: List sub accounts under the manager account

arguments.query: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign_budget.amount_micros FROM campaign

executions.purpose: Audit existing campaigns and budgets in the Google Ads account

arguments.query: SELECT ad_group.id, ad_group.name, campaign.name FROM ad_group
SELECT ad_group_criterion.criterion_id, ad_group_criterion.keyword.text, ad_group_criterion.keyword.match_type, ad_group.name FROM ad_group_criterion WHERE ad_group_criterion.type = 'KEYWORD'

final_message: Audited the Google Ads client account structure, campaigns, ad groups, and keywords using available GAQL streaming tools. Researched targeting and keywords. Due to the absence of dedicated write/mutation tools for campaigns, budgets, keywords, and ads in the tool catalogue, the campaign build step could not be programmatically executed via API, though the audit and planning were successfully completed.
unmet_steps: Programmatically create new search campaign, budget, targeting, keywords, ads, and assets using Google Ads mutate tools (which were not available in the tool catalogue).
